config.name: apiKey
config.description: Your Apify API token for authenticated access. Get it from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required for data retrieval; optional for server discovery and capability listing.

tools.name: get_repo_stats
tools.description: Fetch comprehensive statistics for a specific GitHub repository. Returns total stars, forks, issues (open/closed), pull requests, watchers, last commit date, and contributor count. Returns metrics useful for assessing project popularity and maintenance status.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search across GitHub for repositories matching keywords, sorted by relevance or metrics. Returns matching repositories with description, star count, language, and last update timestamp. Use for finding projects, libraries, or code samples related to specific topics.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by most stars, most forked, or most recently updated (default: relevance)

params.name: query
params.description: Search terms to find repositories (e.g. 'todo app', 'machine learning framework', 'authentication middleware')

params.name: max_results
params.description: Number of repositories to return (default 10, max 100 for comprehensive search)

tools.name: get_repo_languages
tools.description: Analyze the programming language composition of a GitHub repository. Returns percentage breakdown of languages used, dominant language, and file counts per language. Use for understanding project tech stack or evaluating language distribution.

params.name: owner
params.description: Repository owner GitHub username or organization (e.g. 'python', 'golang')

tools.name: compare_repos
tools.description: Compare multiple GitHub repositories side-by-side with key metrics. Returns star counts, fork counts, issues, primary language, and comparative analysis for each repository. Use for choosing between similar projects or analyzing competitive landscape.

prompts.name: repo_comparison
prompts.description: Compare GitHub repositories side-by-side with stars, forks, languages, and activity metrics.

prompts.name: project_evaluation
prompts.description: Evaluate an open-source project for quality, activity, and community health.

resources.name: GitHub API Coverage
resources.description: Supports repository stats, search, language analysis, and multi-repo comparison.
